title: Jerry Jones on Dak Prescott's postgame interaction with driver: Fans can express themselves

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jerry Jones on Dak Prescott's postgame interaction with driver: Fans can express themselves
sources.description: Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott wasn't happy about hearing from a driver after last Thursday's loss to the Buccaneers, but the interaction didn't bother Cowboys owner Jerry Jones.
